sentence: This project studies how HIV enters and fuses with target cells and how host restriction factors stop this.
This project tests whether faulty stem cells in skin, linked to cell metabolism and DNA regulation, cause poor wound healing with age.
This project uses data science to find retinal and blood biomarkers that predict impairment after traumatic brain injury in rodent models.
This project monitors trends and patterns of drug use and drug availability using a wide variety of sources.
This project tests whether stress reactivity links posttraumatic stress symptoms after a myocardial infarction to higher blood pressure.
This project tests machine learning algorithms on wearable devices that detect overeating and stress in real-time.
This project studies how herpes simplex virus 1 particles move inside infected cells and exit them to spread in the nervous system.
This project examines changes in neuronal activities and connectivity in a non-human primate model of parkinsonism, related to reduced novelty and reward seeking behavior.
This project studies the aggregation of the RNA-binding protein Musashi1 with Tau and its role in nuclear dysfunction in Alzheimer's and related dementia.
This project studies how environmental exposure changes RNA pseudouridylation and RNA-protein interactions in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
This project pools brain imaging data from different studies to describe brain aging and relate imaging patterns to cognitive performance.
This project studies how the native membrane environment affects the structure and function of membrane proteins.
This project tests whether delivering junctophilin-2 related gene products can treat heart failure in mouse models.
This project develops methods to model and analyze tumor microbiomes that address contamination and batch effects.
This project builds a label-free dynamic imaging tool to observe immune cells in live tissue in real-time.
This project tests whether helping T cells repair DNA damage can address T cell exhaustion in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
This project provides human tissue collection, processing, and banking for cancer research.
This project tries to find out how environmental variation affects the metabolism of microbial communities.
This project makes cell-type specific maps of poison exons in neurodevelopment and studies how they are alternatively spliced.
This project links health providers to evaluate combined treatments for alcohol use disorder and alcohol-associated liver disease.
